data.exact_reserve_text: The result included a release from prior year reserves of GBP 33.6m (2013, GBP 35.3m release). This release is a result of the Markel strategy to reserve prudently together with the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 719.876m. During 2014 management recorded a release from prior year reserves of GBP 33.6m, primarily attributed to favourable claims development driven by prudent initial reserving and active claims handling. The release represents approximately a 4.7% reduction versus opening gross claims outstanding. No gross prior-year movement broken down by line of business or a gross claims development triangle was provided; the quantified prior year movement is reported in the managing agent narrative and appears to be a net release.

This release is a result of the Markel strategy to reserve prudently together with the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.
